audit.why: Kled owns the skirmish levels, Ornn owns the 2-item teamfight — a genuinely even lane that changes hands.
audit.corrected: diff kept; phase text rewritten so each stage says who owns it and why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ornn rows 1, 2 and 5 and Skill row 3.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Skill, Kled, Ornn, and mirror kled__ornn already flipped rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 to Kled as one group. The page's own whys[1], whys[3] and whys[5] describe Kled winning those rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped to Kled in matched full/content pairs; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kled's shield is called 'Courage of the Colossus', a rune name, and no cooldown appears anywhere.
audit.why: Kled's shield comes from Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (140/125/110s); his damage window is Violent Tendencies, four massive attack-speed swings on 13s at rank 1; Jousting is a 550-range dash on 13s that recasts back through the target; Bear Trap on a Rope is 800 range on 11s and only yanks if the shackle holds for a short duration — walking out denies the pull entirely.
audit.corrected: Fabricated rune name removed, real names and the 11s / 13s numbers written into the phases, trades and cooldowns, and the shackle-break interaction stated.

audit.why: Violent Tendencies is an attack-speed burst window — the wind-up is the cue to disengage, and it is 13s of downtime once spent.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Bear Trap yanks you in on an 11s cooldown and you have no shield yet — concede the level and last-hit.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kled must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies gives four huge attack-speed swings on 13s — even with W up, his straight skirmish still beats yours.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Jousting in and back out on 13s lets him pick trades you cannot refuse — trade with the W exhale, hold your E, and farm safely to 6.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown.
edits.after: His AD spike lands first and shreds through your armour — hold the wave and wait for your second item.

edits.before: Even with W's shield online, Kled's Courage-of-the-Colossus all-in still wins the straight skirmish at this point.
edits.after: Even at 3, Violent Tendencies gives Kled four massive attack-speed swings on 13s and still wins the straight skirmish.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Kled, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind Kled, E into it for the knockup, then W-Brittle — do it while Jousting's 13s is spent and he cannot dash out.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: E with no terrain in the line — no knockup, and Jousting lets him dash through you twice for free.

edits.before: His engage hook. Brittle-tank it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 800 range on 11s — the yank only lands if the shackle holds; walk out.

edits.before: That is Kled's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The trap only yanks if it stays attached — step away the instant it lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Kled restores Skaarl's courage by fighting — disengage, don't feed it.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies is his burst tell — step back on the wind-up, not the cast, and let its 13s run out.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Brittle-tank it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — 800 range, 11s at rank 1; the yank needs the shackle to hold, so walk out. - Violent Tendencies: 13s of burst. - Jousting: 13s, and he can dash back through you.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Bear Trap on a Rope: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade on the 11s Bear Trap and the 13s Jousting: with both down he has no way in or out. Never fight while Violent Tendencies is charged.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 still belong to Kled — his remount aggression and Courage of the Colossus shielding mean a straight skirmish favors him, so trade with W exhale and back off rather than committing E early. Level 6 is your equalizer: when he R-charges in to engage, bait the dismount, then E into your own Q magma pillar to knock him up and stun him as he tries to remount Skaarl, and your own R adds a second long-range double knock-up that wins the all-in. Don't blow E first — hold it for his dismount or you're just feeding a free remount.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 still belong to Kled — Violent Tendencies on 13s and his Jousting double-dash mean a straight skirmish favors him, so trade with W exhale and back off rather than committing E early. Level 6 is your equalizer: when he R-charges in to engage, bait the dismount, then E into your own Q magma pillar to knock him up and stun him as he tries to remount Skaarl, and your own R adds a second long-range double knock-up that wins the all-in. Don't blow E first — hold it for his dismount or you're just feeding a free remount.

notes: 'Courage of the Colossus' is a rune, not a Kled ability — it appeared in whys[2] and mid and is now removed from both. Two claims I did not touch because Riot's text does not support them: Bellows Breath being 'unstoppable' with a shield (spikes[1], early, wants.you[0]), and Searing Charge stunning Kled 'as he tries to remount' — the kit says knock up, not stun, and says nothing about interrupting a remount. Volcanic Rupture's derived 'grounding' flag is likewise unsupported by Riot's description, so I wrote no claim that it denies Jousting.
